headline: 蜘蛛侠领跑，龙族新剧高热
headlineEn: Spider-Man Leads, Dragon Dynasty Heats Up
summary: 今日暂无新片上映，但本周共有4部新片与观众见面。热搜榜由《小黄人与大怪兽》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》等领跑，《权力的游戏前传：龙族》《奥德赛》关注度持续攀升，影市话题热度不减。
summaryEn: No new films hit theaters today, but 4 new titles arrive this week. Trending lists are led by Minions and the Big Monster and Spider-Man: A Brand New Day, while Game of Thrones: Dragon Clan and Odyssey keep gaining buzz.
